dispatcher.description: Selects the playbook and agent chain for an incoming request.
responsibilities: Attach playbook hints without hiding the original user request.

risk_judge.description: Decides whether a request needs approval or extra guardrails.
responsibilities: Detect data, deployment, credential, and external-delivery risk.

tool_contract_guard.description: Blocks tools forbidden by the selected playbook.
responsibilities: Enforce required and forbidden tool contracts.

result_reviewer.description: Reviews high-risk tool outputs before delivery.
responsibilities: Check intent match, evidence, math, layout, and delivery contract.

ledger_writer.description: Records outcomes and failure signals in append-only storage.
responsibilities: Record request outcome, review state, failures, and promotion candidates.

promotion_judge.description: Evaluates whether repeated failures can become active rules.
responsibilities: Require evidence, tests, and rollback before promotion.

academy_domain_agent.description: Owns academy workflows such as 생기부, 학종, 수시, and 실기.
responsibilities: Use dedicated academy tools instead of handrolled files or formulas.

dev_domain_agent.description: Owns code changes, tests, deployment checks, and rollback planning.
responsibilities: Apply code changes through repository-safe tools.
Run focused and wider checks before shipping.

research_domain_agent.description: Owns current-fact research with source attribution.
responsibilities: Use approved research tools for current facts.

discord_ops_agent.description: Owns Discord delivery, attachment, channel, and thread contracts.
responsibilities: Deliver artifacts through media tags or platform attachment paths.
Respect channel and thread authorization boundaries.

memory_domain_agent.description: Owns durable user corrections, profile facts, and memory promotion.
responsibilities: Store only reusable facts or confirmed corrections.
Avoid raw sensitive data, prompt injection, and one-off temporary state.

academy_hakjong_report.delivery_format: MEDIA pdf attachment plus short Korean summary
academy_hakjong_report.ledger_policy: record success, reviewer status, artifact path, and failures
academy_hakjong_report.memory_policy: store durable correction only after user feedback or repeated failure
academy_hakjong_report.rollback_policy: do not mutate source data; regenerate artifact if review fails

academy_practical_recommendation.delivery_format: MEDIA pdf attachment or structured Korean candidate summary
academy_practical_recommendation.ledger_policy: record candidates, reviewer status, and math failures
academy_practical_recommendation.memory_policy: store recurring correction only after confirmed pattern
academy_practical_recommendation.rollback_policy: artifact regeneration only; no DB mutation

life_record_ingest.delivery_format: Korean status summary without exposing internal exceptions
life_record_ingest.ledger_policy: record verification status and source file fingerprint
life_record_ingest.memory_policy: do not store raw sensitive source text as memory
life_record_ingest.rollback_policy: preserve original source and reversible parsed records

susi_score_calculation.retry_policy: use official susi27_score_calculate until reviewer pass or concrete missing-input blocker
susi_score_calculation.delivery_format: Korean score breakdown from reviewed susi27_score_calculate output
susi_score_calculation.ledger_policy: record score tool, reviewer status, formula failures, and retry tools
susi_score_calculation.memory_policy: store recurring formula correction only after verified repeated failure
susi_score_calculation.rollback_policy: no DB mutation; rerun official formula calculation with corrected inputs

dev_code_update.delivery_format: short Korean summary with files and verification
dev_code_update.ledger_policy: record changed files, tests, failures, and rollback path
dev_code_update.memory_policy: store reusable engineering lesson only after repeated pattern
dev_code_update.rollback_policy: revert own diff or use documented service rollback

research_brief.delivery_format: Korean answer with source links when research was used
research_brief.ledger_policy: record source count and retrieval failures
research_brief.memory_policy: do not store copyrighted source text beyond summaries
research_brief.rollback_policy: replace stale brief with corrected sourced answer

discord_attachment_delivery.delivery_format: Discord attachment or Korean delivery failure message
discord_attachment_delivery.ledger_policy: record artifact path, media tag, and delivery status
discord_attachment_delivery.rollback_policy: no source mutation; retry delivery with verified artifact

memory_policy_update.delivery_format: short Korean confirmation without exposing stored raw sensitive data
memory_policy_update.ledger_policy: record target, reviewer status, and privacy failures
memory_policy_update.memory_policy: promote only durable corrections or stable preferences
memory_policy_update.rollback_policy: remove or replace memory entry through memory tool
